bullets.section: What I’m watching and planning on rewatching —
bullets.title: “This is Water”
bullets.note: commencement speech by David Foster Wallace, which he gave at Kenyon College on May 21, 2005. It is [also available in book form](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5ho7oow/opfkhq/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9UaGlzLVdhdGVyLURlbGl2ZXJlZC1TaWduaWZpY2FudC1Db21wYXNzaW9uYXRlL2RwLzAzMTYwNjgyMjU=), but I highly recommend the audio. One of the most impressive humans I know listens to this every two weeks, which is how I first heard it.

bullets.title: StickK bet
bullets.note: This is a detailed and really fun piece on how Donny lost 22 pounds eating mostly food from convenience stores…in Japan! His tips and strategies can be applied anywhere and in any restaurant, and the “Raising the Stakes” section is particularly ingenious ([StickK bet](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5ho7oow/pnceh9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc3RpY2trLmNvbS8=), private Instagram account gambit, etc.). If you’re looking to get leaner and want to lose the excuses, this article is time well spent.

bullets.title: Hybrid - Last Man Standing
bullets.note:
Good for many things, including writing, email processing, anything repetitive, and journaling on big ideas. It’s like an exploratory soundtrack with a side dose of aural hypnotism and EDM.

**Bizarre family activity that I’m happy to help spread —  
[Egg boxing with Bo Boswell](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5ho7oow/60aeh8/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9Cb19Cb3N3ZWxsL3N0YXR1cy85ODkxNDI0OTAyNTQwNzM4NTY=).** This is an outgrowth of Dr. Peter Attia’s [introduction to egg boxing](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5ho7oow/kmbmh6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL0VnZ0JveGluZy92aWRlb3MvMTQwODkwMjE2OTE4NzA2NS8=), which might make sense to watch first. If you watch it, watch the entire thing for a full appreciation of Peter’s OCD. For his less ridiculous exploits, [this podcast](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5ho7oow/52hvh7/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE0LzEyLzE4L3BldGVyLWF0dGlhLw==) is a good start.
